settings_unresolved.log_retrieval: GitHub connector returned BlobNotFound/404, including after terminal cancellation.
settings_unresolved.observed_limits: Step configured10min, job20min, isolated process480s; status remained running beyond these before terminal cancellation.
settings_unresolved.followup: Test-only experiment removes full successful assertion formatting while preserving all four cases and native equality predicates. No timeout increase or test omission.

retained_history_proof.fixture: 7 synthetic line and 7 synthetic manual checkpoint records/day, plus one real Slot 1 save and App loss/day. Public Schedule Done advances to Day 7. This is not an authored-dialogue playthrough.
retained_history_proof.timing_policy: Observations on one shared Windows runner; no speed threshold or physical input-to-paint guarantee.

timing_boundaries.manual_slot_save_us: Production prepare_backup_action(save, slot:1) plus commit_backup_action, including synchronous signal handlers.
timing_boundaries.login_us: Automated Title Login, Backup picker opening and Autosave selection, load consent, restore and awaited process frames.
timing_boundaries.phase_scopes: Each scope is inclusive. Parent and child scopes overlap and must not be summed; repeated phases inside one scope accumulate.
timing_boundaries.phase_collection: Save/load profiles include only labeled manual-save and Title Login measurement windows; startup and opening each daily Backup app before its save timer are excluded.
timing_boundaries.checkpoint_subphases: Version 2 document/schema/proof timers are nested inclusive measurements. History proof timers accumulate across entries; document proof lookup stops at its first miss. Profile instrumentation adds overhead and is not a speedup comparison.

parse_cache_comparison.control: Same checkout and retained user-data source, cloned into a new isolated process per variant. Only DWM_SAVE_PARSE_CACHE_DISABLED differs.
parse_cache_comparison.sampling: One cold Login per variant, fixed disabled-then-enabled order on one shared Windows runner; observational, not a repeated-sample or frame-time guarantee.

manual_prepare_comparison.control: Public prepare_backup_action and commit_backup_action with real storage, the same seeded Day7 journal, immutable capture fixture and a test-subclass fixed clock. Only the discarded eager journal copy in configured capture differs; parse cache and write validation memo are enabled in both.
manual_prepare_comparison.sampling: Eight alternating pairs / sixteen fresh isolated processes; identical prepared candidate, physical source files, target revision and pre-commit parser cache. Preparation timing covers only the public prepare_backup_action call, including immutable fixture copying, and excludes source cloning, journal seeding, proof generation, commit, live UI callbacks, issuer-flush callbacks and rendering. OS filesystem caches are not flushed.

performance.latency_acceptance: Not established. No new optimization is included; measurements are instrumented synthetic-run observations.
